script_text: Uranus is about to light a fire under your Sun, and you will feel it before you can name it. Monday brings Mercury squaring Neptune in your 12th House, clouding financial clarity through overthinking. Tuesday Venus glides into your 1st House, softening your edges and pulling romantic energy toward you. Wednesday Mars enters your 5th House, igniting creative passion but demanding you stop analyzing love. The mid-week turning point arrives Thursday when Jupiter trines Uranus from your 4th House, unlocking sudden breakthroughs in home and career. Friday Mars opposes Neptune, stirring confusion in your partnerships, while Saturn squares Uranus, testing your commitment to change. Saturday, Sunday, Pluto in your 10th House presses for career transformation. Wednesday is your power day because Venus graces your 1st House. Friday is your challenge day as Mars opposes Neptune. Financially, trust gut feelings over spreadsheets. Follow for daily updates.
